{{Quote|Thank you for coming. I'm Bresch.|Gavin Bresch|<ref name="The Heart">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Heart}}</ref>}}
'''Gavin Bresch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Cularin Militia]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. He worked in the Militia's counterintelligence division under the leadership of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xirossk]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], as part of his duties with them, he met the [[Heroes of Cularin]] aboard the ''[[Cularin IV]]'' and asked them to track down a [[Believers]] strike team that was planning to attack an important summit of various [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] leaders.
